remarks: LOCATION! This bright and spacious 2800 SF "country charmer" is surrounded by multi-millon dollar homes on westside cul-de-sac close to town. NEW cedar shingle siding, roof, furnace, central AC and hot water heater. Newer kitchen opens into the adjoining dining room and lovely living room with large picture window, fireplace and sliders to the expansive wood deck. There are four bedrooms and primary has a private full bath and large walk-in closet. The pretty sunroom is perfect for an at home office or additional living and entertaining space. Finished walk-out lower level is paneled with built-ins and half bath, laundry room and has a great playroom/exercise room and office. Set on a lovely private flat acre with an open play yard, stone walls and mature trees, it offers endless expansion possibilities and Percs for a 6 bedroom septic. Extensive list of improvements available.
